Name: Blue-ish Chickens
Author: RowenDoesThings
Description:
I saw "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10258]Sav's Blue Chicken Reskin Variety[/url]" and was absolutely devastated that it was defunct, as the mods that it required to run were no longer supported. So I decided to repackage it and give it new life!

This mod includes 3 recolored versions of the blue chicken, as well as the vanilla sprite itself. Each coloration (including the vanilla blue) is randomized on purchase, each having equal chance of being bought!

You can also customize which skins you'd like to use in-game using the mod "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿"! It's not required but it definitely makes it easier to change if you don't want to use a certain skin!

[size=5][b]To Install:
[/b][/size]1. Install latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].
2. Install latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
3. Unzip "Content Patcher" into the folder [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font][font=Arial].[/font]
4. Install "Blue-ish Chickens".
5. Unzip "Blue-ish Chickens" into the folder [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font][font=Arial].[/font]
(OPTIONAL): Install latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿.
(OPTIONAL): Unzip "Generic Mod Config Menu" into the folder [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font][font=Arial].[/font]

[size=5][b]And Done!
[/b][/size][size=4][b]Enjoy your chickens! <3[/b][/size]

Original skin changes done by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/MM1991?gameId=1303]MM1991[/url].
Code copied and modified from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20043]Elle's Cuter Coop Animals[/url] by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/junimods?gameId=1303]junimods[/url].
